stories.title: Create BEV C04 Performance Assessment with Thermal System Diagnostic Scenarios
stories.description: Build practical performance assessment for BEV C04 (thermal management systems) with 5-7 diagnostic troubleshooting scenarios that align with C04 Work Activities. Each scenario includes expected troubleshooting steps, safety checkpoints, and supervisor assessment rubric (competency levels 1-4) with bilingual terminology.
acceptanceCriteria: bev-diagnostic-rectification/CU04/PA.md created with 5-7 thermal system diagnostic scenarios (coolant leaks, thermal sensor faults, pump failures, etc.) each mapping to specific C04 Work Activities and including step-by-step troubleshooting procedures

Each scenario includes mandatory safety checkpoints (HV isolation, PPE, tool calibration) and assessment rubric scoring competency on 1-4 scale (1=unsafe/incomplete, 4=competent with initiative); bilingual language (EN + BM terminology)
PA.md validated against C04 KK work sheets to ensure all work activities are covered; supervisor assessment rubric cross-referenced with C05 supervisory competency criteria
technicalNotes: File to create: bev-diagnostic-rectification/CU04/PA.md (content: 5-7 diagnostic scenarios with safety checklists and rubrics)
Cross-reference file: bev-diagnostic-rectification/CU04/KK-*.md (map each work activity to PA scenario)
Validation: Ensure all C04 Work Activities from _reference/00-noss-extract.md [C04 Work Activities] are represented in PA scenarios
Validation: Check HV safety terminology matches C01 KP and existing safety documentation

stories.title: [Integration Test] Enhance BEV C01 KP technical depth — HV safety procedures and PPE specifications
stories.description: Write integration tests for the feature implemented in US-001. Story description: Review and enhance BEV C01 KP-01~03 Information Sheets for technical accuracy. Verify HV safety content matches OSHA 1994, EQA 1974, and manufacturer standards. Ensure PPE specifications (Class 0, CAT-III) are correctly detailed with proper Malaysian regulatory references.
acceptanceCriteria: Integration tests exist covering the core behaviour of US-001
Tests cover the happy path and at least one error/edge case
Tests run without requiring external services or manual setup
technicalNotes: Source files from US-001: bev-diagnostic-rectification/C01/KP-01.md, bev-diagnostic-rectification/C01/KP-02.md, bev-diagnostic-rectification/C01/KP-03.md
